title: OWEN PICKED MAN UTD FOR THE TOP FOUR. THEN CAME THE RELEGATION ZONE.
description:
August: top four. November: relegation zone. Michael Owen's prediction aged fast.

Michael Owen tipped Manchester United for the top four in August. By November they were in the relegation zone. Carrick was sacked on the 12th, and Pochettino took over on a deal to 2029.

Owen now says he can't see United going down. Same confidence as August. He reckons relegation would be as big a shock as Leicester's title in 2016, a fairytale in reverse. He also thinks Pochettino can revive Rashford, who, for the record, has no Premier League goal this season.

Is Owen right about United this time, or is this one to frame? Have your say below.
